title: Teaching Assistant/Associate Professor of Agricultural and Resource Economics, Spring 2026
description:
Description

Agribusiness Online Masters Teaching

The successful candidate will be expected to: 1) coordinate and
develop a fully online masters program in agricultural business; 2)
teach undergraduate and graduate courses in the Department of
Agricultural and Resource Economics; 3) mentor students; and 4)
participate in service activities of the Department, College,
University, and profession. The expected start date is January 1,
2027.

Qualifications

The candidate requires a PhD in agricultural economics or a closely
related field. Strong knowledge of the subject matter taught in
graduate courses is necessary. Successful candidates must have a
strong commitment to quality teaching, excellent communication
skills, and a desire to teach and mentor students in digital
environments as well as work with industry stakeholders, faculty,
and staff. Candidates for the Assistant Professor rank should have
demonstrated promise of excellence in the areas of responsibility
assigned to them. For the Associate Professor rank, candidates
should have demonstrated excellence in areas of responsibility
assigned to them, have at least 3 years of college teaching
experience, and have taught graduate-level courses.

Application Instructions

To apply, please submit a letter detailing your interest in the
position, a curriculum vitae, official transcripts, and a list of
three references through Interfolio
https://apply.interfolio.com/186768. Direct any questions regarding
the position to Dr. T. Edward Yu, Search Committee Chair,
Department of Agricultural & Resource Economics, at tyu1@utk.edu . Screening of applicants
will begin on August 1 and continue until the position is
filled.
